calls.title: Cary x Pablo - Enablement Follow-Up
calls.summary: The team discussed enhancing practical training on experimentation tools through hands-on demos and real-world use cases to build skills and confidence. A glossary will be created to clarify terminology and facilitate understanding of experiment types. Upcoming sessions will be tailored based on use cases identified with tech leads, with input needed by Monday. To improve communication, a dedicated Microsoft Teams channel and regular sync meetings will be established for collaboration and issue resolution. Additionally, clearer definitions and examples of experiment types will be documented to streamline processes. Training resources, including presentation materials and customized demos, will be shared for effective learning across the organization.
calls.keywords: Experiment definitions, GrowthBook platform, Use cases, Fact tables, Communication channels, Enablement sessions
calls.action_items:
**Cary Rakin**
Send presentation slides and attach experiment glossary to Pablo and Dmitry for reference to aid understanding of experiment types (07:05)
Coordinate with Chris to prepare tailored use case demonstrations and ensure readiness for the next session based on prioritized use cases and glossary clarifications (09:10)
Set up a Microsoft Teams channel for ongoing communication with Pablo and Dmitry and invite them to join to improve collaboration (10:33)
Schedule bi-weekly or weekly sync meetings with Stradivarius team including Cary and Chris for open Q&A and technical support (11:13)
Offer to involve additional data scientists or resources as needed to support enablement sessions and address technical questions (11:13)

**Pablo Torrecillas Monasterio**
Lead the team discussion during the tech leads meeting to develop and submit a prioritized list of use cases for future sessions to tailor demos and training (07:17)
Confirm internal permissions on dashboard data sharing or decide on alternative demonstration approaches for use in enablement sessions (07:32)

**Dmitry Sopov**
Review the experiment glossary once received to select appropriate experiment types relevant to prioritized use cases for upcoming sessions (08:48)
Collaborate with Pablo to finalize the prioritized use case list for upcoming sessions and submit it by the agreed deadline to allow preparation time (12:16)
